traditions.KJV: A Psalm [ or ] Song for the sons of Korah .

1.english_reference: His foundation [ is ] in the holy mountains

traditions.LXX: Οἱ θεμέλιοι αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις ·
traditions.KJV: His foundation [ is ] in the holy mountains .

2.english_reference: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion

traditions.KJV: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion

2.english_reference: more than all the dwellings of Jacob

traditions.KJV: more than all the dwellings of Jacob .

3.english_reference: Glorious things are spoken of thee , O city of God

traditions.WLC: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ ךְ עִ֖יר הָ אֱלֹהִ֣ים
traditions.LXX: δεδοξασμένα ἐλαλήθη περὶ σοῦ , ἡ πόλις τοῦ θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Gloriósa dicta sunt de te , cívitas Dei .
traditions.KJV: Glorious things are spoken of thee , O city of God .

4.english_reference: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me

traditions.WLC: אַזְכִּ֤יר רַ֥הַב וּ בָבֶ֗ל לְֽ יֹ֫דְעָ֥ י
traditions.LXX: μνησθήσομαι Ῥαὰβ καὶ Βαβυλῶνος τοῖς γινώσκουσίν με ·
traditions.VUL: Memor ero Rahab et Babylónis sciéntium me .
traditions.KJV: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me :

4.english_reference: behold Philistia , and Tyre , with Ethiopia

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְ צ֣וֹר עִם כּ֑וּשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀλλόφυλοι καὶ Τύρος καὶ λαὸς Αἰθιόπων ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce alienígenæ , et Tyrus , et pópulus Æthíopum ,
traditions.KJV: behold Philistia , and Tyre , with Ethiopia ;

5.english_reference: And of Zion it shall be said , This and that man was born in her

traditions.WLC: וּֽ לֲ צִיּ֨וֹן יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭ אִישׁ יֻלַּד בָּ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: Μήτηρ Σειών , ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος , καί Ἄνθρωπος ἐγενήθη ἐν αὐτῇ ,
traditions.VUL: Numquid Sion dicet : Homo , et homo natus est in ea :
traditions.KJV: And of Zion it shall be said , This and that man was born in her :

5.english_reference: and the highest himself shall establish her

traditions.LXX: καί Αὐτὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν ὁ ὕψιστος .
traditions.KJV: and the highest himself shall establish her .

6.english_reference: The LORD shall count , when he writeth up the people

traditions.LXX: Κύριος διηγήσεται ἐν γραφῇ λαῶν καὶ ἀρχόντων
traditions.VUL: Dóminus narrábit in scriptúris populórum , et príncipum :
traditions.KJV: The LORD shall count , when he writeth up the people , [ that ]

6.english_reference: [ that ] this [ man ] was born there

7.english_reference: As well the singers as the players on instruments [ shall be there ]

traditions.LXX: ὡς εὐφραινομένων πάντων ἡ κατοικία ἐν σοί .
traditions.VUL: Sicut lætántium ómnium habitátio est in te .
traditions.KJV: As well the singers as the players on instruments [ shall be there ] :

7.english_reference: all my springs [ are ] in thee

traditions.KJV: all my springs [ are ] in thee .
